item.title: How AI Models Fail To Detect Gendered Hate In Indian Languages
item.description: AI does not create misogyny; it encodes it, because it is built upon and embedded within social structures that have historically normalised the policing, shaming, and disciplining of women. The post How AI Models Fail To Detect Gendered Hate In Indian Languages appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Until Women Are Safe, Human Rights Day Rings Hollow in India
item.description: We must confront difficult realities, sometimes even in our own homes, if we are to genuinely effect change. We need to challenge "common sense," modernize antiquated systems, and create a society where women can live freely rather than cautiously.
